clauses.requiredBehavior: Inspect and reuse qualified, versioned components.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Duplicate an owned capability for convenience.
clauses.binding: Reuse existing merged evidence only: bounded package results/third-party/cp-739efe7-f3-q2q3-bounded-20261030 (PR #254 merge 01c1da1c, protocol sha256 ff252192...18b0d2), D-1 isolation package, original F3-A and readjudication packages, dossier 08. No new test, harness or fixture is authored or run.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Identify the controlling source, external reliance boundary, duties, expected acceptance and the authority by which a proposed change may acquire canonical standing.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Start against an unnamed or mutable contract.
clauses.binding: Controlling sources are exact-source bound: CP 739efe7d (src tree d248bde4), Registry pin a40fe755, Registry records 02, 03, 06, 11, 12, 13, 14 on Registry main 6b96a9a6, hub main 01c1da1c. Authority order: frozen contract text and record 12 Class A control; records 06/11 are builder-prepared, human adoption pending; evidence-method requirements and historical oracle expectations are ranked below and kept distinct.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Distinguish implementation inspection, independent qualification, competent certification and final integration; preserve independence wherever required.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Fit an oracle to implementation or substitute developer tests.
clauses.binding: Adjudication is kept apart from execution and certification: this lead builder adjudicates read-only; Workers A-D analyze separate members/contract; Worker E challenges the combined findings. All share one session lineage, so none is independent; no organizational independence, formal acceptance or certification is claimed. The Architect decides.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Version, authenticate and review governance-critical policy and rule changes; protect established mandatory invariants against configuration override.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Treat unreviewed settings or evaluator changes as governing authority, weaken mandatory checks or introduce an unaccountable decision path.
clauses.binding: Protected invariants are untouched: no guard, evaluator, frozen oracle, test or protocol is changed; no authorization or refusal requirement is weakened; any proposed clarification is a PROPOSAL that must not weaken runtime authorization, refusal or evidence requirements. Historical verdicts (original F3-A FAIL, 23 assertions) are preserved.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Preserve relied-upon external semantics or obtain an explicit authorized compatibility transition.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Introduce silent contract, rights, evidence or interface regressions through internal refactoring.
clauses.binding: External interface commitments are preserved: no implementation, schema, reason vocabulary or contract text is amended; Options B and C are proposals only and are not adopted; standing holds (Registry #58/#59, Control Plane #87, constructor tolerance, Ed25519 #26/#34, V09, DEF-OBS-TOL-OVERFLOW-1, R1, final Tier 1, release/production) are unchanged.
